items.name: Riverlake 2026
items.information:
Varmt välkomna till Riverlake 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Maximalt en gäst / medföljande per deltagare på grund av tävlingslokalens storlek. Ingen utomstående publik tillåten.

--

A warm welcome to Riverlake 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** Maximum one guest / accompanying person per competitors due to the size of the competition venue. No external visitors allowed.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: UJCV Cubing Honduras 2026

venue.name: [Universidad José Cecilio del Valle](https://ujcv.edu.hn/)
venue.address: Universidad José Cecilio del Valle, Boulevar Roberto Romero Larios, Comayagua

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1NDc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--72b0f75423beefdc650f133783cee9ed7de0cd11/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-01-13%20at%2010.05.16%20AM.jpeg)
Esta competencia forma parte de una serie de tres eventos que se desarrollarán a lo largo del año 2026, coincidiendo con los tres períodos académicos. El objetivo principal de esta serie es fortalecer el desarrollo del speedcubing en Honduras, brindar más oportunidades de competencia oficial y contribuir a la mejora progresiva de los tiempos y rankings a nivel nacional.

El evento se llevará a cabo en la Universidad José Cecilio del Valle, campus Comayagua, institución que brinda el espacio y apoyo logístico para la realización de competencias oficiales WCA, reconociendo el valor educativo, formativo y tecnológico del speedcubing.
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

This competition is part of a series of three events that will take place throughout 2026, corresponding to the three academic periods. The main objective of this series is to strengthen the development of speedcubing in Honduras, provide more opportunities for official competition, and contribute to the progressive improvement of national times and rankings.

The event will be held at Universidad José Cecilio del Valle, Comayagua campus, which provides the venue and logistical support for the organization of official WCA competitions, recognizing the educational, formative, and technological value of speedcubing.

items.information:
